title: Quick Crispy Moroccan Split Peas Tagine
description: A briny and crispy Moroccan dish featuring split peas, perfect for meal prep, made with sous-vide and paleo-friendly ingredients. This recipe combines the flavors of Morocco with a modern twist.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 180 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the split peas, olive oil, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the mixture to a sous-vide bag and seal.
Cook the mixture in the sous-vide machine for 2 hours.
Remove the bag from the sous-vide machine and let it cool.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the cooked split pea mixture.
Cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the mixture is crispy and golden brown.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for an additional minute.
